ana: Drafted relnotes section for quantization recommendations. Main points: recommended Q4 profiles, perf tradeoffs, and migration tips for Dedicated/Private. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4228

bryce: Nice. Could we add a short how-to for the quantized model fallback behavior? Folks will want to know what happens when a quantized variant is chosen vs the full-precision model.

maria: I started a Known Issues bullet: 
- Some tensor shapes may produce slightly different logits under 4-bit configs; were tracking a regression ticket.
Also flagged a note that eval baselines need re-run for quant profiles.

ana: (typo) meant ana: @maria good call Can you add a short repro snippet for the regression ticket? A tiny snippet helps the QE team.

maria: sure, adding a minimal curl example and a link to the issue in the PR.

ryan: Heads-up: Ruby SDK snippets are still missing. We merged a small API change for client init last week (`Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ...)` -> `Redwood::Client.connect`), so any old Ruby examples will break. I can add Ruby examples if someone confirms the preferred streaming example.

bryce: For Ruby streaming, we should show the enumerator pattern. Proposed: 
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.connect(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp_enum = client.chat.create(model: 'kitefish', streaming: true)
resp_enum.each do |chunk|
  puts chunk.content
end
```
Add one-liner about API rename.

ana actually not in participants. Ignore.

ryan: Also added a short YAML snippet for the routing policy example in relnotes (to show opt-out): 
```yaml
routing_policy:
  preference: cost
  allow_quantized_fallback: true
```

bryce: tiny wording tweak for the relnotes: say "quantized fallback may change model outputs slightly; test your prompt sets when flipping to quant profiles." Saves confusion.

maria: +1 to that wording. I'll update the known issues bullet accordingly.

ana: LGTM. If no blockers from QA in the next hour I'll merge and tag the release notes.
